mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `user` (username, password, nickname, avatar, phone, role, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{avatar}, #{phone}, #{role}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, nickname, avatar, phone, role, status, create_time, update_time FROM `user` ORDER BY id LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
